name: The AI Business Case: Investment and ROI
description: How to turn an AI idea into an investment case that survives scrutiny: value driver trees, honest baselines, full cost of ownership for seat, token and capacity pricing, risk-adjusted scenarios, pilots that produce evidence, and benefits realization after go-live.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: The AI Business Case: Investment and ROI

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 14 lessons in 5 modules; and pass the final exam: 15 questions, 30 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
